title: Herbaceous Middle Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: A fragrant, low-sodium lamb tagine with red wine, herbs, and apricots that serves as a crowdpleasing main course.

ingredients.name: Spice mix (cumin, coriander, paprika, cinnamon, turmeric, black pepper)

instructions: Preheat oven to 160 °C (325 °F). Place tagine or Dutch oven on stove.
Heat olive oil over medium‑high, sear lamb cubes until browned on all sides, about 5–7 min. Transfer to a plate.
In the same pot, add diced onion and cook until translucent, about 4 min.
Stir in minced garlic and cook 1 min until fragrant.
Add sliced carrots and sauté 3 min.
Return lamb to the pot, pour in red wine, stir to deglaze, scraping up brown bits.
Add broth, herb blend, spice mix, lemon zest, and apricots. Stir well.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and transfer to the oven for 1 h 45 min or until lamb is fork‑tender.
If needed, cook 15 min more to reach desired tenderness.
Remove from heat, let rest 10 min, then garnish with fresh parsley and cilantro before serving.
